finance.withholdingProductHint: Applied automatically to VAT-registered buyers when the VAT-inclusive total exceeds the yearly VUK 232 limit.
finance.chargesHint: Charges follow the VAT rate of the main delivery; with several rates they are split pro rata (VAT Law 24/b).
finance.importVatHint: Import: VAT is paid at customs; the supplier invoice carries no VAT.
finance.exemptionRequired: An exemption code is required for a 0 % VAT line.
finance.frozenHint: Document completed; tax amounts no longer change when rates change.
finance.taxPointSaved: Tax point date and exchange rate updated.
finance.warning.withholdingBelowThreshol: No withholding: the VAT-inclusive total ({total} TRY) does not exceed the {limit} TRY limit.
finance.warning.withholdingSplit: Note: together with the same customer's orders of the day the total is {total} TRY; split sales are assessed together for the withholding limit.
finance.warning.withholdingBuyer: Withholding {code} not applied: the buyer is not VAT-registered / a designated buyer.
finance.warning.withholdingSellerExempt: Withholding {code} not applied: the company is flagged as importer / ore producer.
finance.warning.withholdingExemptLine: Withholding {code} does not apply to an exempt line.
finance.warning.importVat: Import: VAT is paid on the customs declaration; enter the declaration data.
finance.warning.withholdingPurchase: Withholding {code} not applied: the supplier is not VAT-registered, or the code is limited to designated buyers (Settings > Tax rates).
finance.warning.withholdingSupplierExemp: Withholding {code} not applied: the supplier is flagged as importer / ore producer.
finance.warning.fxStale: The {currency} rate is dated {rateDate}; the tax point calls for the {expected} bulletin, which could not be confirmed with TCMB. Fetch or enter the rate before the document is finalised.
finance.warning.fxProvisional: The tax point calls for a bulletin not published yet; the latest {currency} rate ({rateDate}) is used as an estimate and re-read at the tax point.
